network_status.network: Modellazione idrologica del bacino del Cedrino alla diga Pedra 'e Othoni
network_status.summary_it: Lo studio ARPAS ricostruisce i deflussi alla diga e mostra la calibrazione dell'evento, ma non tabula un valore riferibile a questo secondo ponte sul Cedrino.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPAS study reconstructs dam inflow and shows event calibration but tabulates no value attributable to this second Cedrino bridge.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
